amendment_timing: Made BEFORE any sentiment data was analysed. No Binance metrics/funding history or Bitget recorder sentiment has been loaded into any analysis; the only fetched Binance data remains the unanalysed v1.1 availability smoke test. Rules below are derived from recalled practitioner/academic ideas, not from data.
reason: Owner instruction (issue #27): use community experience. Web search was unavailable, so every prior below is RECALLED FROM MEMORY and labelled 'recalled, unverified citation'. No URL, paper, author, or number is cited or invented. A prior is a hypothesis to be tested, never evidence.

community_priors.label: recalled, unverified citation
community_priors.a_crowd_vs_top_traders: Retail/crowd long-short ratios are often described as contrarian at extremes (existing R1/R2), while top-trader POSITION ratios are described as 'smart money' whose divergence from the crowd is worth following.
community_priors.b_open_interest_and_price: OI up + price up = trend confirmation (existing R3); OI up + price flat/down = crowded positioning / squeeze risk (new R8); sharp OI drop = liquidation flush then mean reversion (existing R4).
community_priors.c_taker_flow: Taker buy/sell volume imbalance as short-horizon momentum; already covered by R5's taker filter. No new rule (cap of 3 new rules).
community_priors.d_funding_extremes: Extreme funding rates are described as contrarian: crowded longs paying high positive funding precede pullbacks, deeply negative funding precedes squeezes up (new R6).
e_known_pitfalls: Ratios are exchange-specific samples (Binance accounts/top traders), not the whole market; transfer to Bitget is unproven (Stage 2 stays mandatory).
Regime dependence: effects may flip between bull/bear/range; the 705-day confirmation span may cover few regimes; no regime conditioning is added (would add degrees of freedom).

Look-ahead from timestamp alignment: metrics stamped at period end; klines assigned to close-time bar; funding is used only from its settlement bar forward and expires after 96 bars (8h), never carried further.
Overlapping events: non-overlapping events (12-bar hold) and 5-day blocks retained; block inference remains unvalidated.

unchanged_from_v1_1: rules R1-R5 and their grids (24 grid points)
horizon 12 bars, entry next-bar close, non-overlapping events
period, discovery/embargo/confirmation split, 5-day blocks, freeze + sha256, one-shot ledger
status ladder criteria (events>=30, net>=5bp at 22bp, plateau, Holm p<0.05, >=20 blocks)
no efficacy claim, no trading advice

R6_funding_extreme_contrarian.data: Binance data/futures/um/monthly/fundingRate/<SYM>/ (calc_time, last_funding_rate); Bitget recorder funding for Stage 2
R6_funding_extreme_contrarian.sign_hypothesis: CONTRARIAN, declared in advance: funding > 0 -> short; funding < 0 -> long. Opposite sign = hypothesis falsified, not re-labelled.
R6_funding_extreme_contrarian.default_basis: narrative; Binance baseline funding is 0.0001, so default is 5x baseline
R6_funding_extreme_contrarian.data_gate: >=95% of declared days with >=2 funding settlements; otherwise rule skipped (Holm family size unchanged)

R7_top_vs_crowd_divergence.data: metrics sum_toptrader_long_short_ratio (top-trader position ratio) -> r/(1+r), versus global account long_ratio. Amends v1.1 'toptrader unused'.
R7_top_vs_crowd_divergence.sign_hypothesis: FOLLOW THE TOP TRADERS, declared in advance: top more long than crowd -> long; top more short -> short.
R7_top_vs_crowd_divergence.data_gate: >=95% of declared days with >=95% of bars carrying top_long_ratio; otherwise rule skipped

R8_oi_price_divergence.signal: 12-bar OI change >= level AND 12-bar return <= 0 (OI up, price flat/down = crowded positioning)
R8_oi_price_divergence.sign_hypothesis: SQUEEZE / REVERSAL UP, declared in advance: long. (OI-up-with-falling-price could alternatively be read as bearish continuation; that reading is NOT tried.)
R8_oi_price_divergence.data_gate: none beyond the v1.1 day-coverage gate

multiplicity.secondary_stock_like_family: separate, own Holm count, 36 per symbol, never pooled
multiplicity.holm: Step-down over the full count even if a rule is skipped by its data gate (conservative). The code (GRID_TOTAL=36) applies the per-symbol count; the cross-symbol family count above is the declared reporting standard and must be applied when results are pooled for the verdict.

level_adjustment_rule.text: If ~67% or ~80% fits better than the narrative 70% default, the grid already contains it (R1/R2 grid 0.60..0.85, 0.05 steps; 0.67 is bracketed by 0.65/0.70, 0.80 is in-grid). A level may be adjusted to the observed best level on DISCOVERY only; it becomes 'proven' only via one-shot confirmation on the frozen level. Off-grid values are not added.

status_ladder: unchanged: narrative_default -> candidate (discovery) -> proven (Stage-1 confirmation, Binance source-venue only) -> transfer_pending -> Bitget-venue statement only after Stage 2. Community-prior rules start at narrative_default like all others; a prior never grants status.
claims: No efficacy claim, no trading advice. Community-prior origin is not evidence. 'proven' = pre-declared screen passed on Binance only.
reproduction: python3 -m research.sentiment_rules --binance-metrics research/data/binance_raw/metrics --binance-klines research/data/binance_raw/klines5m --binance-funding research/data/binance_raw/funding  (exits 2 while gates unmet)
